描述_ZN: Hiring Pang" scroll, Ming, painted by Ni Duan, on silk with color, 163.8 cm in length and 92.4 cm in width.　　The painting is based on the story of Liu Biao, the assassin of Jingzhou, who hired the hermit Pang De Gong during the Three Kingdoms period. Pang De Gong was the uncle of the famous scholar Pang Tong, who had a close friendship with Xu Shu, Zhuge Liang and other wise men. The figures are finely drawn, the colors are beautiful, the landscape is majestic and thick, and the woods are lush and clear.　　Signed "Chujiang Ni Duan". Inscriptions: "Jinxing Painting History", "Zhongzheng Painting and Calligraphy" and "Yi Shi Zuhua" in Zhu. There are also other seals of authenticity such as "Qianlong imperial treasure".
